mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_log (user_id, login_id, action, target_type, target_id, detail, client_ip, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{loginId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, #{clientIp}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT log_id, user_id, login_id, action, target_type, target_id, detail, client_ip, created_at FROM activity_log WHERE action = #{action} ORDER BY log_id DESC
